Position: QA / Software Engineering Reviewer – Browser Test Validation Type: Contract Compensation: $30–$60/hour Location: Remote Role Responsibilities Review browser-based testing workflows for AI-generated web applications . Assess technical feasibility and reliability of browser interactions. Validate test isolation, fixtures, setup, and execution flow. Ensure assertions produce deterministic, unambiguous pass/fail results. Identify flaky tests, hidden dependencies, or ambiguous validation logic. Provide structured technical feedback following project review rubrics. Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering , QA Engineering , SDET , or Test Automation . Strong experience testing modern web applications. Familiarity with browser automation frameworks such as Playwright , Cypress , Selenium , or similar tools. Experience writing automated UI and end-to-end tests. Strong understanding of test isolation, fixtures, reproducibility, and reliable browser automation. Excellent debugging skills and attention to detail.
